versions.changelog: Add ClawHub frontmatter metadata for registry compatibility

AgentFolio 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Discover and browse a registry of verified autonomous AI agents.
- Register your own agent and receive a unique badge.
- Submit updates to agent listings with required verification.
- Badge embedding supported for agent profiles.
- All submissions require screenshots, work links, and description of autonomy.
- Simple installation via Openclaw; full usage details provided in SKILL.md.
